pages.title: Ujyalo Learn — AI Tutor for Grades 1–12 & SEE in Nepal
pages.description: Free AI tutor for students in Nepal: Grades 1–12 and SEE preparation. Ask questions in English or Nepali, generate quizzes, save notes and follow a study plan based on your real progress.

pages.title: Features — AI tutor, quizzes and study tools
pages.description: Seven tutoring modes, four quiz types with explanations, notes and flashcards, a study planner and progress tracking built from your own quiz attempts.

pages.title: Subjects and grades — Grades 1–12 and SEE
pages.description: Nine subjects across Grades 1–12 and SEE preparation: Mathematics, Science, English, Nepali, Social Studies, Computer Science, Optional Mathematics, Health and Economics.

pages.title: Pricing — free core plan, paid plans later
pages.description: Ujyalo Learn is free to use today, with fair-use limits on AI requests. Future plans are clearly marked as planned and no payment is taken on this site.

pages.title: Help and FAQ — getting started
pages.description: How to create an account, ask the tutor a question, generate a quiz, plan study time and fix common problems, plus a setup guide for the site owner.

pages.title: About — built for students in Nepal
pages.description: Why Ujyalo Learn exists, how it handles AI honestly, and the person behind it — founded and built by Riyaz Chalise for students in Nepal.

pages.title: Contact Ujyalo Learn
pages.description: Reach the Ujyalo Learn team about support questions, privacy requests, reported content or account deletion.

pages.title: Privacy Policy — what we store and why
pages.description: What Ujyalo Learn collects, where it is stored, who can read it, how long it is kept, and how to export or delete your account and data.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.description: The rules for using Ujyalo Learn, including acceptable use, AI limitations, accounts for minors and parental consent.

pages.title: Courses — guided learning paths for Grades 1–12 and SEE
pages.description: Short learning paths that combine tutor explanations, self-marking quizzes and flashcards. Every session links to a real tool, so progress is measured rather than declared.

pages.title: Study guides and resources — written and attributed
pages.description: Short, original guides on revision, exam technique and study habits. Every resource states its source and licence, and we do not host textbooks we have no rights to.

pages.title: SEE preparation — habits that move marks
pages.description: How to prepare for SEE in Nepal without cramming: timed practice, a mistake log, a four-week plan and honest notes on what is and is not official exam material.

pages.title: FAQ — is it free, is it official, who sees my data
pages.description: Straight answers about Ujyalo Learn: cost, accuracy limits, whether it is official curriculum, data privacy, and what a parent should know.

pages.title: Content and copyright policy
pages.description: What Ujyalo Learn publishes, what it refuses to publish, how attribution and licensing work, and how to report an error or a rights issue.

pages.title: Accessibility statement
pages.description: How Ujyalo Learn approaches keyboard access, contrast, reduced motion, small screens and language, plus the limitations we know about.
